info.longName: DFA U.S. Vector Equity Portfolio – ETF Class Shares

funds_data.description: The fund purchases a broad and diverse group of equity securities of U.S. operating companies. It invests in companies of all sizes, with increased exposure to smaller capitalization, lower relative price and higher profitability companies as compared to their representation in the U.S. Universe. The Advisor generally defines the U.S. Universe as a market capitalization weighted set of U.S. operating companies listed on a securities exchange in the United States that is deemed appropriate by the Advisor.
